## Link vetting checklist (see SOP.md §2)

- [ ] Link resolves over HTTPS (HTTP 200, final URL is the resource)
- [ ] Legitimate domain (official/scholar/publisher/institution/platform) — no shorteners, IP literals, or lookalike domains
- [ ] No executables/archives or deceptive download buttons
- [ ] File download (PDF/EPUB) only from a trusted publisher/library
- [ ] Title + description accurate; resource still maintained

## Format checklist (see SOP.md §3)

- [ ] Correct section, alphabetical order
- [ ] Format: `- [Name](url) - Description ending with a period. \`Tag\``
- [ ] No duplicate (canonical URL checked)
